answer: World ID makes each extra identity pay one live iris scan at an Orb, about $40 from a real person; a farm running N fakes pays N×$40 and cannot share it because one iris code belongs to one person and opens one seat. Each scan becomes a 12,800-digit code checked against 18 million verified, with no room for copies: a zephyr of duplicate codes disperses, a vine of borrowed eyes fails, and a walnut shell cannot hide a second iris. A farm reusing one iris dies by iris-code match at 2: the second registration is refused and both seats void.
